messages.text:
can't sleep... keep thinking about packing for the trip lol  
weather's finally warming up, u know? makes me wanna wear actual clothes again 😅

It sounds like your mind is buzzing with anticipation for the trip and the change in seasons. Sometimes excitement can make it hard to wind down, even when you want rest. Have you tried jotting down your packing list before bed to help your brain let go for the night? What’s the trip about—vacation, work, or something else?

kinda both excited and weirdly stressed? like i wanna feel chill on the beach, but also... i keep thinking about wearing t-shirts  
not even bc of my body or whatever, just—ugh, stupid marks on my arm won’t heal fast enough lol  
probably from that cheap soap jake keeps buying 🙄

I hear you—it’s frustrating when something small and physical keeps nagging at you, especially before a trip you want to enjoy. If the marks are from irritation, switching to a gentler soap and using a plain moisturizer may help them settle faster. Does the skin feel itchy, tender, or just look marked? We could think through some quick care steps for the days before you leave.

totally jake’s fault lol he never listens when i say that stuff burns my skin  
i told him a million times to get the sensitive kind but nooo  
and now i gotta deal with it right before vacation?? classic

It’s annoying when someone ignores what you’ve clearly asked for, especially when it affects your comfort. That frustration can add to your stress, so it might help to focus on what you can control now—like getting a gentler soap yourself and starting a simple skin routine. Have you got time to pick one up before your trip? We could talk about quick remedies so you feel more confident on the beach.

eh it’s fine, not a huge deal  
i’ll just wear long sleeves for a few more days, no biggie  
soap thing’s just like… every day stuff u know? he does it with everything  
not worth fighting over lol

It sounds like you’ve decided it’s easier to let some things slide than to push for change, even if they’re annoying. That can keep the peace, but it might also leave you feeling unheard over time. How do you usually handle these recurring little frustrations with Jake? We could explore ways to address them gently so they don’t build up.

ugh don’t even get me started on that  
tbh i don’t wanna talk about it, just… wish he’d listen once in a while  
can we just talk about something else? like, i dunno, beach vibes or whatever 😅

Sure, we can focus on lighter things. What’s your favorite part of the beach—sunbathing, swimming, or maybe walking along the shoreline? Imagining that can help shift your mind from stress to relaxation. How do you picture your first day there?

i love walking barefoot in the sand, when the sun’s warm but not burning  
and that sound of waves? total vibe  
i wanna just… float, y’know? no thoughts, no jake, no stupid soap drama lol

That sounds like a peaceful, grounding scene—warm sand, gentle waves, and you fully in the moment. Visualizing it can be a great way to relax before bed. You could even focus on that sensory picture tonight to help calm your mind. Want me to guide you through a short “beach walk” visualization?

nah i'm good, don't need a whole guided thing lol  
just talking about it helps a little, honestly  
kinda like... airing it out?

That makes a lot of sense—sometimes just saying it out loud can release some of the tension. It’s good that beach thoughts can give you a bit of space from the stress. You might keep coming back to that image whenever your mind starts spinning. Do you feel a bit more ready for rest now?

yeah... weirdly enough, kinda do  
like, still tired, but less stuck in my head?  
so... thanks i guess lol

I’m glad talking helped you feel a bit lighter. Sometimes a small shift in focus is all it takes to quiet racing thoughts. I hope you can ease into rest tonight and wake up feeling ready for your trip. Sleep well.

u didn’t push or anything… so yeah, thanks for that  
i’m gonna try to sleep now lol  
night 💤
You’re welcome, and I’m glad it felt comfortable for you. Rest well and enjoy those beach vibes in your dreams. Night 🌙
